author: A

components.title: Set up acid balance equation
components.what: Write 0.20(18) + 0.40x = 0.35(18 + x), representing total acid before and after mixing.

components.title: Solve for x
components.what: Expand and simplify to 0.05x = 2.7, then divide to get x = 54.00 liters.

components.title: Verify final concentration
components.what: Plug x=54 back in: total acid = 3.6+21.6=25.2, total volume=72, ratio=25.2/72=0.35, confirming correctness.

log.author: A
log.draft:
Set up the acid balance equation, where x is the liters of 40% solution added:

0.20(18) + 0.40x = 0.35(18 + x)

Solve:
3.6 + 0.40x = 6.3 + 0.35x
0.05x = 2.7
x = 54

Verification:
- Initial acid: 0.20 × 18 = 3.6 L
- Added acid: 0.40 × 54 = 21.6 L
- Total acid: 3.6 + 21.6 = 25.2 L
- Total volume: 18 + 54 = 72 L
- Final concentration: 25.2 / 72 = 0.35 = 35% ✓

Cross-check via alligation (lever rule): distances from target to endpoints are 35−20=15 and 40−35=5, giving ratio added:original = 15:5 = 3:1, so x = 3×18 = 54, matching the algebraic solution.

FINAL: 54.00
